text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. (We just talked on the 
phone, but since I have the chance, I 
thought I'd write a letter too... hehe.)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
“I'm running in a race in Morioka today!! 
Who'd have thought they'd actually go and 
call me the ‘Local Star’?!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I ran into a club underclassman there 
(the one who cried so much when I left for 
Tokyo!), but... I heard she's quitting 
running."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even though she loved running so much, 
just because she lacked talent... ...That 
girl who smiled and said she'd run in the 
Central league just like me when she saw 
me off."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's why I decided to show everyone 
a truly dazzling run! As the 'Star of 
Morioka,' I'll give them somethin' to 
dream about...!"
